cards.text: The LORD has just given Moses rules for the lamps and the bread in the Tent of Meeting (Leviticus 24:1-9). Now, in Israel's camp, the son of an Israelite mother and an Egyptian father goes out among the Israelites. A fight breaks out between him and an Israelite.

cards.question: Then the son of the Israelite woman does something serious. What is it?

answers.text: He steals from the man's tent
He runs off from the camp

cards.text: So they bring him to Moses, Israel's leader. And right here the text stops to name his mother: Shelomith daughter of Dibri, of the tribe of Dan.
Moses doesn't decide this one on his own, and nobody rushes it. I respect that, friend, because the one time I pulled a batch out early, it looked PERFECT on top and the middle was still dough.

cards.question: While they wait, what do they do with the blasphemer?

answers.text: They send him back to his tent
They hand him over to his family

cards.question: They hold the blasphemer until the will of the ___ is made clear to them.

cards.text: Then the LORD speaks to Moses: take the blasphemer outside the camp, and the whole assembly is to stone him. This part is heavy, friend.

cards.question: Before the stoning, who does the LORD say is to lay their hands on the blasphemer's head?

cards.text: But the LORD isn't done. He tells Moses to give the Israelites a law: anyone who curses his God shall bear the consequences of his sin, and whoever blasphemes the name of the LORD must surely be put to death, stoned by the whole assembly.

cards.question: The LORD says the law against blaspheming His name covers native Israelites but not foreign residents.

cards.text: Then the law moves from words to actions. If a man takes the life of anyone else, he must surely be put to death.

cards.question: If someone kills an animal, the LORD says he must make restitution, not be put to death.
Then the LORD turns to injuries. If anyone injures his neighbor, it's fracture for fracture, eye for eye, tooth for tooth. What's the idea behind that rule?

answers.text: The penalty is twice the injury
The injured man names the penalty

cards.text: Then the LORD sets two cases side by side: whoever kills an animal must make restitution, but whoever kills a man must be put to death. And the foreign resident and the native are to have the same standard of law.

cards.question: What reason does the LORD give for one standard of law for the foreign resident and the native?

answers.text: He is the LORD their God
The tribes asked Him for it
Moses could not judge each case

cards.text: Then Moses speaks to the Israelites, and they take the blasphemer outside the camp and stone him. So the Israelites did as the LORD had commanded Moses.
